At centre the curved inner lip of the aperture meets tightly winding ridged exterior; pearly pale copper, cream and moss grey, the opening is partially visible. Complete shell occupies 85% of frame, macro nature photography, soft tidepool light. IMPORTANT: this full image will be shown magnified 3.4x around the exact centre, leaving only approximately the central 29% visible during the question. Make that central area contain TWO coherent diagnostic material/structural details of the named object, not the entire silhouette, not blank texture, and not a disconnected fragment. Full image reveals the complete object naturally. Rich but restrained environment palette. No lettering, logos, watermark, hands, labels, borders, collages or question marks. No ivory studio background. Physical realism and fair visual evidence matter more than decoration.
